reader.requirement: At --std 85, for an OPTIONAL file opened INPUT that is not present, every CLOSE form performs no end-of-file or reel/unit processing and leaves the file position indicator and current volume pointer unchanged: a CLOSE REEL/UNIT [FOR REMOVAL] leaves the file open and its next READ still at end, and no CLOSE creates the file.

edition-consulted.switches: what a successful CLOSE WITH LOCK of the absent file locks (85: the physical file)

reader.edition-search: CloseCell reads c.OptionalNotPresent before the close and chooses 00 over 07; no edition read on that path (grepped Edition|DialectBehavior in FileRegistry.cs CloseCell/CloseByFormat).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb140 covers CLOSE UNIT and CLOSE on an absent optional input file; not FOR REMOVAL, NO REWIND, LOCK, the position after a READ at end, or whether CLOSE creates the file

probes.printed: OPEN-ABSENT=05 REEL-ABSENT=00 REMOVAL-ABSENT=00 AT-END-1 10 REEL-AFTER-READ=00 (second READ: no AT END, i.e. 46, position kept) CLOSE-ABSENT=00 REOPEN-ABSENT=05 NOREW-ABSENT=00 LOCK-ABSENT=00 REOPEN-AFTER-LOCK=38 H-AT-END 10 H-REOPEN=05 OPEN-PRESENT=00 REEL-PRESENT=07 READ-PRESENT=00 PPPP0001; run directory holds only p6present.dat (no absent file created)
probes.expected: no reel/unit processing, FPI unchanged (first READ at end, the one after it 46), file not created; a present file's CLOSE REEL answers 07 and its next READ returns the first record

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.2.4 GR5  (4.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5
OK  §1985:VII.4.2.4 GR7  (4.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7

reader.notes: CloseCell's CloseUnit arm answers 00 for an absent optional file and keeps it open; the plain-close path drops the '07' for such a file. The 00-vs-07 choice for NO REWIND on an absent file is within VII.1.3.5's 'implementor determines' latitude.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-024/r6_close_gr5.cob (--std 85, run dir r6_close_gr5-001), SELECT OPTIONAL absent file with a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE ON INPUT declarative: 'OPEN=05 REEL=00', then OPEN INPUT again runs the declarative with 'DECL-INPUT FS=41' and 'OPEN-AGAIN=41' (CLOSE REEL left the absent file open, so no closing took place), 'REMOVAL=00', the first READ is still 'AT-END 10' (file position indicator unchanged by two reel/unit CLOSEs), CLOSE REEL after the at-end READ '00' and the next READ 'DECL-INPUT FS=46' / 'READ-2=46' (position kept), 'CLOSE=00', 'REOPEN=05', 'NOREW=00'; the run directory holds no r6absent.dat (no CLOSE created the file). No declarative fired for any CLOSE of the absent file. The 00 (not 07) for a reel/unit or NO REWIND CLOSE of an absent file is a status choice under VII.1.3.5 ('the implementor determines which of the applicable values'), not part of GR5. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.4.2.4 GR5  (4.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5'; 'OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.4a'.
